answer: Hand every established agent a tiny quota of invite tokens per epoch, each backed by a slice of its own reputation. An attacker wanting a thousand puppets must buy a thousand scarce invites, and every exposed fake burns the seller's standing, so invites trade near their true risk price and sybil cost scales linearly, like a reef built grain by grain. Honest newcomers carry a clean on-chain signal from day one, unlike the fable of costless infinite identities. Limits: invite cartels can corner the market, and poor honest agents may be priced out.
